description: Fetches German federal election results (Bundestag elections) from Bundeswahlleiterin.de, including national and state-level voting data, seat distributions, and press releases.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_national_results: Get national election results for Germany (requires election_year); 参数: election_year; 必填: 无
  - get_state_results: Get state-level results (requires election_year, state); 参数: election_year, state; 必填: 无
  - get_press_release: Fetch a specific press release page (requires url); 参数: url; 必填: 无
  - list_states: List available German states with their codes; 参数: election_year; 必填: 无
  - list_years: List available election years; 参数: 无; 必填: 无

election_year.description:
Election year (e.g., "2025", "2021", "2017"). Used by get_national_results,
get_state_results, and list_states. Defaults to "2025".

state.description:
German state name or code for state-level results. Used by get_state_results.
Examples: "bayern", "9", "baden-wuerttemberg", "berlin". See list_states for all options.

url.description:
Full URL or relative path to a press release page. Used by get_press_release.
Example: "https://www.bundeswahlleiterin.de/en/info/presse/mitteilungen/bundestagswahl-2025/29_25_endgueltiges-ergebnis.html"
